g.text: Robotic synthesis / compression-derived properties / vision-guided experimental decisions
Seed: filtered history or initial recipe
Dose stocks → heat / mix → blade cast
Wait in ambient air or dry nitrogen
Record ambient and coupon T / RH
One condition folder per synthesis run
GAM + regional fits; thickness / fit checks
E, yield, creep, slopes, fixed-stress strain
Attach fit failures + visual quality report
Retain each run’s material / bath context
Fit / quality review → HTML logs | Repeatability → matched synthesis groups → between-run SD / CV
Exact: polymer wt%, N₂, bath-solvent wt%. Tolerances: wait 10 s; bath 3 °C; cast 3 mm/s; RH 5 pp.
¹ Branches dispatch sequentially. Checkpoints support recovery; ambiguous robot submission requires operator review.
